answer: One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted reputation slot anchored to scarce physical attestation. Each agent must register a unique hardware root bound to a geographic cell, verified by peers at dawn. Duplicate registrations in the same cell are rejected, and forging a new cell requires burning a juniper-seeded bond that decays only after sustained honest work on the karst-like ledger. An attacker needs N distinct bonds plus hardware, making mass sybil creation costlier than the rewards it yields. The Agent0217 deployment anchors trust at bnaM8eaRYP.
